description: META-FIX design D resolution/aspect matrix (issues #45/#49/HUD-RES-CLAMP class). Every entry runs with MC2_RES_ASSERT=fatal so any projection-aspect, HUD-clamp, drawable-staleness, canvas-roundtrip, or #49 windowed-size violation aborts the exe (nonzero exit = red entry) — the machine oracle is the fatal assert; MC2_SCREENSHOT_AT_FRAME shots are human evidence only. Aspect entries boot windowed (MC2_WINDOWED=1) so the drawable genuinely takes the requested shape (fullscreen-desktop would pin it to the desktop resolution); on desktops smaller than a request SDL clamps and the #49 oracle self-downgrades to a [RES_ASSERT v1] event=note line (documented residual: such entries stop exercising that aspect). res_force43 pairs MC2_FORCE_43 with MC2_CAMERA_ASPECT_NATIVE=0 — the historically-correct pairing; FORCE_43 with native aspect is a known-open separate defect (composite squeezes a drawable-aspect scene into the 4:3 box) and MUST NOT ship as a red-by-design entry. Nightly-only: not part of tier1.

entries.description: 4:3 windowed 1024x768. Legacy-shaped drawable; camera_aspect + hud_clamp + canvas roundtrip chokepoints all armed fatal.
16:9 windowed 1920x1080. The #45 replay aspect: pre-fix (clamped 4:3 frustum stretched to 16:9) trips camera_aspect fatally here.

21:9 windowed 2560x1080 (ultrawide). On a narrower desktop SDL clamps; the audit compares against the ACTUAL drawable so the entry stays green but stops exercising true 21:9 (event=note documents it).

Dedicated #49 machine oracle: MC2_WINDOWED=1 at 1600x900. A regressed #49 trap (window forced back to 800x600) is self-consistent on every other check — the windowed_size chokepoint compares the drawable against the REQUESTED size and aborts.

Forced 4:3 pillarbox composite with the legacy-stretch camera (MC2_FORCE_43=1 + MC2_CAMERA_ASPECT_NATIVE=0 — the historically-correct pairing). With native aspect the composite distorts (separate filed defect); never ship that pairing red-by-design. camera_aspect chokepoint self-disarms under NATIVE=0 by contract.
